definitions.gloss: very busy, hectic, having a packed schedule
definitions.explanation: Having an extremely full schedule with many tasks or obligations. More formal and emphatic than {忙|いそが}しい.

examples.japanese: {多忙|たぼう}な⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
{多忙|たぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}めていて→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧、⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I'm extremely busy and have no time to rest.

examples.japanese: {多忙|たぼう}な⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合間|あいま}→合間：05708_aima⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縫|ぬ}って→縫う：00326_nuu⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to find time for my family between my hectic schedule.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal and literary than ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧, which is the everyday word for "busy." {多忙|たぼう} is used in written contexts, formal speech, and when emphasizing an extreme level of busyness.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧: busy (everyday, casual)
- {多忙|たぼう}: very busy (formal, written)
- ⟦{繁忙|はんぼう}→繁忙：22531_hanbou⟧: extremely busy (formal/business; often in ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧, busy season)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多忙|たぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to be extremely busy
- {多忙|たぼう}な⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧: hectic everyday life
- {多忙|たぼう}な⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧: a packed schedule
- {多忙|たぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧: due to being busy
